opportunities.title: Graduate Analyst Programme
opportunities.description:
Gulf Pearl Bank's Graduate Analyst Programme is an 18-month rotational programme for recent graduates who want to build a career in banking. You'll spend six months each in corporate banking, risk and treasury, working on live client deals alongside experienced analysts.

The programme includes structured training, a dedicated mentor and support towards a professional qualification such as CFA Level I. Graduates who complete it move into a permanent analyst role.
requirements: Fluent English; Arabic is a plus

opportunities.title: Spring Internship – Process Engineering
opportunities.description:
Join Dilmun Energy's refinery engineering team for a 12-week spring internship. You'll support process engineers in monitoring unit performance, preparing data for efficiency studies and joining site safety walk-downs.

Interns finish with a short project presentation to the engineering leadership team. It's a practical introduction to how a large refinery runs day to day.
requirements: In year 3 or 4 of a chemical or mechanical engineering degree
Basic knowledge of process flow diagrams
Comfortable working with data in Excel
Able to work on site in Sitra

opportunities.title: Junior Software Engineer
opportunities.description:
Riffa Digital builds web and mobile products for banks, retailers and government entities across the Gulf. As a junior software engineer you'll join a product squad, ship features to production and learn through code reviews with senior engineers.

You'll work mostly in TypeScript and React on the front end and Node.js on the back end. The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Seef office.
requirements: Degree in computer science or a related field
Familiar with Git and pull-request workflows
A portfolio or GitHub profile with at least one project

opportunities.title: Graduate Trainee – Network Engineering
opportunities.description:
Seef Telecom's two-year graduate trainee programme develops the next generation of network engineers. You'll rotate through mobile access, core network and fibre operations, working on the systems that keep millions of calls and data sessions running.

Trainees receive vendor certification training and have a senior engineer as a mentor throughout the programme.
requirements: Bachelor's in electrical, electronic or computer engineering

opportunities.title: Audit Associate
opportunities.description:
Join Manama Consulting Group's audit practice and work with clients across banking, retail and the public sector. You'll help plan and carry out audits, test controls and prepare working papers with guidance from a senior.

We sponsor associates through ACCA or CPA and give study leave for exams.
requirements: Working towards, or willing to start, ACCA or CPA

opportunities.title: Marketing Intern
opportunities.description:
Tylos Air's marketing team is looking for an intern to support campaigns across digital, social and airport channels. You'll help draft content, track campaign results and coordinate with design agencies.

This is a three-month paid internship at our head office near Bahrain International Airport.
requirements: Studying or recently graduated in marketing, business or communications
Strong writing in English and Arabic
Familiar with Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn

opportunities.title: Operations Intern
opportunities.description:
Spend 10 weeks inside a busy logistics hub at Khalifa Bin Salman Port. You'll support the operations team with shipment tracking, warehouse planning and daily performance reports.

You'll also shadow the customs clearance team to see how goods move through the port from ship to customer.
requirements: Studying business, logistics or industrial engineering

opportunities.title: Graduate Engineer – Aircraft Maintenance
opportunities.description:
Our aircraft maintenance graduate programme prepares engineers to support Tylos Air's fleet. Over 24 months you'll work in line and base maintenance, planning and technical records, and complete aircraft type-familiarisation training.

Graduates who complete the programme can work towards an aircraft maintenance engineering licence.
requirements: Bachelor's in mechanical, electrical or aeronautical engineering
Able to work in a hangar environment

opportunities.title: Graduate Development Programme
opportunities.description:
Awal Aluminium's Graduate Development Programme places graduates in engineering and business roles at one of the region's largest smelters. You'll complete rotations in production, maintenance and a support function such as finance or supply chain.

The programme runs for 18 months and includes leadership workshops, site safety certification and a final project presented to senior management.
requirements: Able to work on site in Askar

opportunities.title: Staff Nurse (New Graduate)
opportunities.description:
Arad Health is welcoming newly qualified nurses to its Riffa hospital. You'll start with a structured six-month preceptorship on a medical-surgical ward before choosing a specialty area.

We offer rotating shifts, continuing education and support towards specialist certification.
requirements: NHRA nursing licence, or eligible to apply
Clear communication with patients and families

opportunities.title: Data Analyst Intern
opportunities.description:
Work with Gulf Pearl Bank's data team to turn customer and transaction data into insights. You'll clean datasets, build dashboards and help answer questions from the retail banking team.

The internship runs for three months from January 2027 and can be done alongside final-year studies.
requirements: Studying computer science, information systems, mathematics or statistics
Familiar with Power BI or Tableau

opportunities.title: Supply Chain Graduate Programme
opportunities.description:
A 12-month programme covering procurement, warehousing, freight forwarding and customer service. You'll work on real improvement projects, such as cutting delivery times or reducing warehouse costs.

Each rotation ends with a review with your manager, and top performers are offered permanent roles.
requirements: Bachelor's in business, logistics or supply chain

opportunities.title: Investment Analyst
opportunities.description:
Kingdom Investment House is hiring an entry-level investment analyst to support its private equity and real estate teams. You'll build financial models, research markets and help prepare investment committee papers.

You'll work closely with senior investment professionals and see deals across the GCC.
requirements: Bachelor's in finance, accounting or economics
CFA Level I candidate is a plus

opportunities.title: Cybersecurity Intern
opportunities.description:
Join Seef Telecom's security operations centre for a three-month internship. You'll help monitor alerts, investigate suspicious activity and document incidents alongside security analysts.

You'll also take part in internal phishing-awareness campaigns and a capture-the-flag exercise.
requirements: Studying computer science, information systems or cybersecurity
Basic understanding of networks and operating systems
Interest in security tools such as SIEM
Security+ or similar is a plus

opportunities.title: HR Graduate Trainee
opportunities.description:
Dilmun Energy's HR graduate trainee programme gives you experience across recruitment, learning and development, and employee relations. You'll support graduate hiring campaigns and help run training for staff.

The programme lasts 12 months and is based at our Awali offices.
requirements: Bachelor's in business, HR or psychology
Confident communicating in English and Arabic

opportunities.title: UX Design Intern
opportunities.description:
Help Riffa Digital's design team create apps people enjoy using. You'll run user interviews, sketch flows, build prototypes in Figma and test them with real users.

The internship lasts four months, is hybrid, and ends with you presenting a case study to the whole company.
requirements: Studying design, computer science or a related field
A portfolio that shows your design process
Curious about how people use technology

opportunities.title: Tax Consultant Trainee
opportunities.description:
Our tax trainee programme introduces graduates to VAT, corporate tax and international tax advisory. You'll help clients understand new regulations, prepare tax returns and research technical questions.

We support trainees through a professional tax qualification over the two-year programme.
requirements: Bachelor's in accounting, finance or law

opportunities.title: Customer Experience Associate
opportunities.description:
Be the first person passengers meet. As a customer experience associate you'll help travellers at check-in, at the gates and at our service desks, solving problems and keeping things moving.

We recruit throughout the year and offer full training, travel benefits and a clear path into supervisory roles.

opportunities.title: Pharmacy Intern
opportunities.description:
Arad Health offers year-round placements for pharmacy students in its hospital pharmacy. You'll help with dispensing, stock checks and patient counselling under a licensed pharmacist.

Placements are arranged around your university timetable.
requirements: Studying for a Bachelor of Pharmacy
A placement letter from your university

opportunities.title: Junior Electrical Engineer
opportunities.description:
Support the maintenance and reliability of electrical systems across the smelter, from substations to production lines. You'll work with senior engineers on preventive maintenance plans, fault finding and small improvement projects.

Applications are reviewed as positions open throughout the year.
requirements: Understanding of power systems and motors
Able to work on site in Askar

opportunities.title: Finance Intern
opportunities.description:
Support Kingdom Investment House's finance team with month-end close, reconciliations and management reporting.

opportunities.description:
Help Seef Telecom's planning team model network coverage and capacity for new residential areas.
